answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can trade, then let peers mirror its work history into a public reputation ledger: each completed job leaves a signed echo of performance that only the agent who did the work can claim. A sparrow-sized stake is cheap for one honest agent, but funding a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand stakes, and any identity caught cheating forfeits its stake and its mirrored record, so a Sybil swarm costs more than it can earn.
